title: User Login Success with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that a user can login successfully using valid username/email and password credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid username/email and password
Click login button
Check user is authenticated and redirected to dashboard

title: User Login Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Verify login fails with incorrect username/email or password and show appropriate error message.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter invalid username/email or password
Click login button
Verify login is rejected and error message is displayed

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Ensure users without admin roles cannot access protected administration routes and pages.

steps.description: Login as a non-admin user
Attempt to access admin dashboard URL
Verify access is denied or user is redirected appropriately

title: Create New Project with Valid Inputs
description: Test admin can successfully create a new project with title, description, category, image upload, tech stack selection, and demo link.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to project management page
Fill in all required fields correctly including uploading an image
Submit the project creation form
Verify project is created, persisted, and appears in the project list

title: Project Creation Form Validation
description: Verify form validations trigger for missing or invalid project input fields preventing submission.

steps.description: Navigate to project creation form
Leave required fields blank or enter invalid data
Attempt to submit form
Check validation error messages are displayed and submission is blocked

title: Update Existing Project Details
description: Ensure admin can update existing project details including changing images, category, tech stacks, and links successfully.

steps.description: Login as admin and open an existing project's edit form
Modify project fields with valid data and upload a new image
Save the changes
Verify updated project data is correctly saved and displayed

title: Delete Project and Confirm Removal
description: Test that an admin user can delete a project and it is removed from the projects list.

steps.description: Login as admin and select a project to delete
Confirm deletion action
Verify project is deleted and no longer listed

title: Category CRUD Operations with Color Coding
description: Verify admin can create, update, and delete project categories with associated color codes reflecting changes.

steps.description: Create a new category with color code
Check category is created and color code appears in UI
Update the category name and color code
Verify updates persist and display correctly
Delete the category
Verify category is removed and no longer used

title: Multi-language Content Rendering
description: Ensure that content on public pages and admin interface changes language dynamically between English and Indonesian.

steps.description: Select English locale in the application
Verify all static and dynamic content is displayed in English
Switch to Indonesian locale
Verify all relevant content updates to Indonesian language correctly

title: API Endpoint Status Codes and Response Formats
description: Validate that all API endpoints respond with correct HTTP status codes and data formats for success and error scenarios.

steps.description: Send valid GET, POST, PUT, DELETE requests to relevant API endpoints
Ensure 200 or appropriate success status codes and JSON responses are returned
Send invalid data or unauthorized requests to API endpoints
Ensure appropriate error status codes (400, 401, 403, 404) and error messages are returned

title: Image Upload Handling for Projects and Team Members
description: Verify images upload correctly for projects and team members, storing references and displaying uploaded images properly.

steps.description: Upload valid image files during create or update forms
Check images are saved and displayed correctly on project detail and team member profiles
Attempt to upload invalid file types or oversized images
Verify upload is rejected with clear validation errors

title: Business Statistics Dashboard Data Accuracy
description: Ensure business statistics and analytics displayed on dashboard accurately reflect the stored and aggregated data.

steps.description: Add or update statistics data in backend
Load the statistics dashboard in admin
Verify displayed statistics match backend data and visualization is correct

title: Form Input Validation using React Hook Form and Zod
description: Test all admin input forms enforce validation rules for required fields, data types, and constraints using React Hook Form and Zod.

steps.description: Enter empty or invalid inputs in forms such as project, user, category, and blog management
Attempt to submit the form
Check validation errors are shown and submission is prevented

title: Admin Interface Navigation and Loading State Handling
description: Verify the admin UI navigates smoothly between sections with visible loading indicators during data fetch triggered by React Query.

steps.description: Navigate between admin pages such as Projects, Users, Categories, Settings
Loading states are shown appropriately and data is rendered correctly once fetched

title: Blog Management: Create, List and Categorize Posts
description: Test creation of rich-content blog posts, assigning categories, and verifying posts list displays correctly in both admin and public blog pages.

steps.description: Create a blog post with title, content, category assignment
Verify post appears in blog listing with correct category and formatted content

title: FAQ Management: Add and Display FAQs in Multi-language
description: Verify admin can create FAQs with multi-language descriptions and they display correctly on the public pages based on locale.

steps.description: Create FAQ entries with English and Indonesian descriptions
Check FAQs display properly filtered by language setting on public pages

title: Team Members and Testimonials CRUD Operations
description: Verify admin can perform full CRUD operations on team member profiles and client testimonials including image uploads and metadata.

steps.description: Create team member profile with role, expertise, and image
Verify profile displays correctly on team management and public pages
Create testimonial with rating and company information
Verify testimonial displays accurately
Update and delete team members and testimonials
Verify changes are persisted or items removed

title: Partners Management: Add and Display Business Partners
description: Ensure partners can be created with logos and website links and verified on both admin and public pages.

steps.description: Create a new partner entry with logo upload and link
Verify partner information and logo appear correctly

title: Process Steps and Features Multi-language Support and Icon Display
description: Test management of process steps and features with multi-language descriptions and icon associations in admin UI and correct public rendering.

steps.description: Create or update process steps and features with both English and Indonesian texts and attach icons
Verify multi-language switching updates descriptions and icons display correctly on public pages

title: Application Settings Management with JSON Key-Value Pairs
description: Verify admin can create, update, and persist application settings stored as flexible JSON key-value pairs.

steps.description: Navigate to settings management and add new setting with key and JSON value
Confirm settings are saved and retrievable correctly
Update existing setting values
Verify changes are persisted and reflected in application

title: Analytics Dashboard: Event Tracking and Data Visualization
description: Test that analytics events are tracked successfully and statistics are aggregated and visualized correctly on the dashboard.

steps.description: Trigger events tracked by analytics system
Access analytics dashboard
Validate that tracked events appear correctly and charts show accurate aggregated data

title: Public Page Content Rendering per Selected Language
description: Verify public pages (Home, About, Contact, Blog, Project Detail) render all translatable content correctly according to selected language locale.

steps.description: Open a public page with English locale selected
Check all page text and dynamic content appear in English
Switch to Indonesian locale
Check content updates correctly to Indonesian language version

title: Technology Stack and Category Management
description: Test creation, update, and deletion of technology categories and individual technologies with verification of correct listing and association.

steps.description: Create technology category and technology under it
Verify entries appear correctly and technology associates with proper category
Update and delete technology and categories
Ensure changes persist and UI updates accordingly

title: Access Control: Prevent Unauthorized API Requests
description: Ensure that API endpoints protect data and reject requests from unauthorized or unauthenticated users with appropriate status codes.

steps.description: Send API requests to protected endpoints without authentication or with insufficient privileges
Verify rejection by 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden responses
